answer: Keeping 260 identities alive needs 260 resharing ceremonies per epoch, since stale shares cannot sign. Shares are proactively reshared every epoch, so a stolen share from last epoch is useless today. The pearl check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The resharing transcript is published, and any party missing the ceremony is dropped from the group. The kernel record is public, the lotus cost is per identity, and 260 aliases cost 260 times one honest seat.
